split.rule: 按 raw_sample 日期排序后按 train/valid/test 比例切分；官方 8 天数据默认约为 6/1/1。

behavior_supervision.rule: raw_sample 先通过 adgroup_id 映射到 ad_feature.cate_id/brand；对每条曝光样本，若同一 user_id + cate_id + brand 在曝光 time_stamp 之后 behavior_label_window_seconds 秒内出现对应 btag，则该行为标签置为 1，否则为 0。
behavior_supervision.note: behavior_log 不含 adgroup_id，因此这里是类目/品牌粒度、曝光后时间窗口内的行为监督，不是广告 ID 粒度的直接标签。

data_transformation: none; feature_map uses published vocabulary sizes; local symlinks to checksum-verified files
history: released seq_len row-prefix histories, capped to100 by unchanged UniRank loader
limitations: cart/fav/buy are user/category/brand matches within a later24h window, not direct ad-ID outcomes
Released action history encodes these delayed labels at impression positions; availability at request time is not established
Released seq_len is row order; equal timestamp events may appear in history
Vocabularies and static side information follow published whole-data encoding
publication_note: Within-release architecture transfer comparison, not a claim of causal deployment performance or a comparison with KuaiRec AUC
